findings.title: Masked stranger "Player" still shows a permanent player ID (VS intro)

where.state: 1v1 random match, searching / match found; both players

findings.current: The 1v1 opponent is shown as "Player" (teen masking) but the card still prints the #ID (#G8RW2B / #RG8H3M), which lets anyone find and friend-request a masked teen.
findings.expected: A masked stranger shows no #ID tag on any online surface (intro, results).

files.why: publicUser masks username and photo but still sends the permanent id
passes tag={opp0?.id} to the opponent PlayerCard
renders #tag whenever a tag is given

change: In publicUser, send no public tag for a masked user (e.g. masked:true, or the id only in friend rooms) while keeping the internal uid for seat keys
In OnlineMatch hide the tag on the opponent PlayerCard when the opponent is masked

criteria: Digest lines teen-masking `.om-matchup .om-pc-tag` disappear from MP-MATCH-01
